turns.user_utterance: I finally got my new card and was very excited to use it today. However, my payment kept declining. What is happening?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—card payments being declined can happen for a few reasons. First, have you already activated your new card? Also, when you tried to pay, did the terminal show any specific error (e.g., “declined,” “insufficient funds,” or “contactless not available”)?

turns.user_utterance: Yes, I activated it as soon as I got it. The terminal just displayed “declined” and didn’t give any other message.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—since the terminal only says “declined” and you’ve already activated the card, the most likely issue is a card payment being rejected. A few quick checks: are you paying in the same country/currency as your card is set up for, and was it the first attempt today (sometimes retrying after 10–15 minutes helps)? If you tell me whether it was contactless or chip/swipe, and the merchant country, I can guide you to the exact next step.
